research: Analysed sharp-wave ripple (SWR) dynamics from spontanous population activity recorded in acute hippocampal network.
Developed minimal population firing-rate model for hippocampal CA1 circuit to obtain bistable states - representing SW and baseline activity.
Tracked mice poses and behavior using machine learning based open source tools.
Developed analysis pipeline for ECoG recordings of evoked neural activity from macaque auditory cortex.
